title: More Mother Tongue Teachers for Preschools
what_it_is: More Mother Tongue Teachers for Preschools

sections.label: Early Childhood Diploma intake increase
sections.summary: Early Childhood Diploma intake at polytechnics rose over 70% from 380 places in 2015 to 675 in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Diploma intake at the polytechnics has increased significantly by more than 70% from 380 places in 2015 to 675 in 2016.

sections.label: Growth in local MTL teachers
sections.summary: Since 2015, efforts have grown the pool of local MTL teachers by 35% to about 3,300 today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Since 2015, all these efforts that I have mentioned have grown the pool of local teachers dedicated to MTL teaching by 35% to about 3,300 today.

sections.label: PCP mid-career switches
sections.summary: In 2015 and 2016, the PCP effort attracted 255 mid-career switches into the MTL preschool sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In the last two years, 2015 and 2016, Mr Ang would be happy to note that the PCP effort has attracted 255 mid-career switches, that is, persons switching into the MTL preschool sector.

sections.label: Early Childhood Manpower Plan
sections.summary: MOE and ECDA developed the Early Childhood Manpower Plan to make the ECCE sector a more attractive and rewarding career.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: MOE and ECDA have developed the Early Childhood Manpower Plan to make the Early Childcare and Education (ECCE) sector a more attractive and rewarding career through a few steps.

sections.label: Local MTL preschool teachers
sections.summary: Six in 10 MTL preschool teachers are locals, and efforts to attract local MTL teachers will be doubled.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Currently, six in 10 MTL teachers in the preschool sector are locals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier that we will double our efforts to continue to attract local MTL teachers into the sector.

sections.label: Bridging programmes for MTL teachers
sections.summary: Former primary MTL and retired non-MTL teachers must undertake brief bridging programmes to enter the preschool MTL sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For example, if the teacher was previously teaching in primary school and teaching MTL, what the teacher would probably need to do is to undertake a bridging programme in early childhood education, a brief one, a bridging programme, so that he or she can then ease into the preschool sector to teach MTL.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: If a retired teacher was previously teaching non-MTL subjects – Maths, Science or others – then, we will require the retired teacher to undertake a brief bridging programme to cover the early childhood education and also MTL, contextualised for the preschool sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We are committed to explore all possible avenues to continue to augment our pool of local MTL teachers.
